Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
You may be able to, depending on how far along the order is.
If the order has not been processed yet, a delivery address change may still be possible. Orders move quickly, so changes are only possible very soon after placing the order and are not guaranteed.
Once an order has been processed, we cannot change the delivery address or make any other changes. If that happens, please send the parcel back to us once it arrives for a refund. If you cancel your whole order within 14 days of receiving your goods, we will refund the cost of standard delivery as part of that order. If you paid for a faster delivery service, we will only refund the standard delivery cost.
For future orders, you can update your saved addresses in your account:
Log in and select My account from the person icon in the top-right corner
Click the downward arrow next to your initials, then choose Profile
In Saved addresses, click the pen icon to edit an address, or + Add to add a new one
If you would like me to guide you through anything else, just let me know.
